title: X-Ray, distributed tracing and OpenTelemetry against AWS

videos.script: Checkout is slow. The API team's dashboard is green. So is the payments team's. Everybody's service is fast, and the customer still waits. {{green}} The time goes somewhere between the services, and no single service's metrics can see it. {{between}} A trace follows one request across every service it touches. Each service writes its part, a segment, with a shared trace id. Put together, they say where the time went. {{trace}} This lesson writes the two segments of a checkout, sends them to moto, and reads them back as a waterfall. Four hundred and twenty of five hundred and twelve milliseconds are spent waiting on the card network, two services away. {{waterfall}} Then the two questions that come with tracing. How many requests to keep, and how to instrument once for any backend, with OpenTelemetry. {{otel}} By the end, slow means somewhere, and you know how to find where. {{end}}
